note: Inclusion 3 "surface IG negative BCP-ALL and an IG::MYC rearrangement unless they have a concurrent BCL2/6 rearrangement" only admits that subgroup, but MYC Structural Variation is published as required of every patient, so nearly all newly diagnosed B-/T-ALL cannot match. Also KMT2A !SV is global though the text excludes KMT2A-r only at "Age < 365 days" (subgroup-exclusion), and ETV6 !Mutation excludes somatic ETV6 mutations though the text excludes only "germline ETV6 mutation" syndromes (wrong-exclusion).

Text admits "Ewing-like sarcoma (i.e. translocation-positive small blue round cell sarcoma other than Rhabdomyosarcoma)", yet Rhabdomyosarcoma is published as an included diagnosis. Ewing Sarcoma, Ewing Sarcoma of Soft Tissue, Round Cell Sarcoma NOS and age >2/<50 are right.

Resected stage IIB-IV melanoma "per AJCC ... cutaneous melanoma staging criteria"; published Melanoma/Cutaneous Melanoma, and the excluded "Uveal melanoma" sits outside the Melanoma subtree. No age bound in the text.

Text: "Have high-grade glioma", but the published list includes the parent Diffuse Glioma, whose subtree also covers Pediatric-Type Diffuse Low-Grade Glioma, Glioma NOS and the grade-2 adult-type gliomas. The specific HGG nodes are already listed, so the parent only adds low-grade patients.
Relapsed or refractory Wilms tumor, "≥18 months old and <18 years old"; published as Wilms' Tumor, >=1.5 and <18.
relapse/refractory cHL, "≥ 16 years"; published as Classical Hodgkin Lymphoma, >=16.
high-risk neuroblastoma, "Age >18 months"; published as Neuroblastoma (+ Ganglioneuroblastoma by design), >1.5.

Text: "aggressive mature B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma ... including BL, BAL, DLBCL, PMBCL", but the parent Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma is published, which pulls in all Mature T and NK Neoplasms and indolent B-NHL. The excluded "primary central nervous system (CNS) lymphoma" (Primary DLBCL of the central nervous system node) is also not written. Age >=0.5/<30 is right.

Only patients over 80 in Parts B/C are cut off by <81; none in a paediatric service. [reader: Text: "16-80 years old for dose escalation cohorts; ≥ 12 years for backfills (Part A), ≥ 12 years old (Parts B and C)" gives no upper bound for backfill/Parts B-C, but age <81 is published globally, so R/R B-ALL patients aged 81+ cannot match. Diagnosis (B-ALL) and >=12 are right.]
R/R or MRD+ B precursor ALL, youngest cohort "Age ≥ 12 years and <17 years"; published as B-Lymphoblastic Leukemia/Lymphoma, >=12.

Parts A/B (any solid tumour): "less than or equal to (≤)18 years"; only Part C neuroblastoma allows "<21". Published as one OR with age <21 for all, so non-neuroblastoma solid tumours aged 19-20 can match. Diagnoses (_SOLID_ + neuroblastoma) are right.

Text admits only "B-precursor B-ALL or DLBCL/Burkitt lymphoma" and "neuroblastoma or Ewing sarcoma", but _LIQUID_ and _SOLID_ are published alongside the specific nodes, so every cancer patient matches.

Text: "a locally advanced or metastatic solid or primary CNS tumor" with "an activating RET gene alteration", but diagnosis is published as only Low-Grade Glioma NOS / Pilocytic Astrocytoma. RET-altered thyroid carcinomas and other solid tumours in 12-21-year-olds cannot match. RET Any Variation and age >=12/<22 are right.
Newly diagnosed lymphoblastic lymphoma, "Age <18 years"; published as B- and T-Lymphoblastic Leukemia/Lymphoma (OncoTree has no lymphoma-only node), <18.
Ph+ CML-CP, "≥1 and less than 18 years", BCR-ABL1 transcript required, "T315I mutation" excluded; published as CML nodes, >=1/<18, BCR::ABL1 SV and ABL1 !p.T315I.

Pediatric arms escalation part and Japan Cohort C only: Confirmed diagnosis of CD123+ BALL, but B-Lymphoblastic Leukemia/Lymphoma is not published (only AML, BPDCN, MDS), so it loses. Over-match: "Confirmed diagnosis of acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL)" is excluded, but !APL with PML-RARA is not written under the published Acute Myeloid Leukemia (exclusion-not-written).

Title: "Pediatric Patients with Advanced Solid Tumors and Hematological Malignancies", and inclusion needs only "histopathologic confirmation of malignancy" (the exclusions mention chloromas), but only _SOLID_ is published. Paediatric R/R haematological malignancies cannot match (_LIQUID_ missing).

Text limits enrolment to "the 2 cohorts: Rhabdomyosarcomas (RMS), Malign Peripheral Nerve Sheath Tumors (MPNST)", but about 27 other soft-tissue sarcoma nodes are published (Synovial Sarcoma, Leiomyosarcoma, Liposarcoma, Sarcoma NOS ...). Age >=12 is right.

Text: "relapsed, or refractory pediatric solid malignancy excluding osteosarcoma", but _SOLID_ is published without !Osteosarcoma, so osteosarcoma patients match. Also no age is published though Conditions give "Between ages 2 and 21" (age wider than text).
FLT3 (ITD/TKD) positive R/R AML, "≥ 6 months and < 21 years"; published as Acute Myeloid Leukemia, >=0.5/<21, FLT3 Mutation.
Age > 12 months but < 18 years B- or T-lineage ALL, "Ph+/BCR-ABL ALL" excluded; published as B-/T-Lymphoblastic, >1/<18, BCR !Structural Variation.
Refractory "Ewing sarcoma of the bone or soft tissues", "Age ≥ 2 years and ≤ 21 years"; published as both Ewing nodes, >=2/<22 (GD2 is an antigen and is not encoded).
Ewing's sarcoma or osteosarcoma, "Age> 9 years and ≤ 21 years"; published as Ewing nodes + Osteosarcoma, >9/<22.

Rhabdomyosarcoma is published but EWSR1 SV is also required, so almost no RMS patient can match. [reader: Text: "Ewing-like sarcoma (i.e. translocation-positive small blue round cell sarcoma other than Rhabdomyosarcoma)", yet Rhabdomyosarcoma is published as an included diagnosis. Its exposure is limited because EWSR1 Structural Variation ("evidence of EWS translocation") is also required. Age >=1 is right.]
HGG (WHO grade III or IV) or DIPG, "≥ 12 months and < 18 years"; published as the HGG nodes including Pediatric-Type Diffuse HGG and Diffuse Midline Glioma H3 K27-Altered, >=1/<18.
Histologically confirmed diagnosis of neuroblastoma, "Age > 1 year and < 18 years": published Neuroblastoma (+Ganglioneuroblastoma by design), >1 and <18.

Text admits only "localized Osteosarcoma" and "osteosarcoma or Ewing's sarcoma rendered disease-free after first relapse"; published also lists Adamantinoma, Chondrosarcoma and Chordoma, which the text never includes.

Exclusion "Currently active Burkitt, T cell, NK/T-cell lymphoma/LPD, Hodgkin, plasmablastic..." not written: Posttransplant Lymphoproliferative Disorders subtree includes the child node Classical Hodgkin Lymphoma PTLD, which should be !excluded. Sarcoma/LMS and PTLD otherwise fine; PID LPD cohort "closed in Amendment 3".

non-uveal, Stage III (unresectable), or Stage IV (metastatic) melanoma published as Melanoma (Skin subtree only); non-uveal mucosal melanomas (Head and Neck Mucosal Melanoma, Anorectal Mucosal Melanoma, Mucosal Melanoma of the Vulva/Vagina, also Conjunctival Melanoma) sit outside that subtree and cannot match. Age >=12 correct.

Neuroblastoma ... MYCN not amplified published as MYCN '!Copy Number Variation', which also shuts out non-amplified tumours with a recorded MYCN gain; a curator might narrow it to amplification only. Diagnosis correct; stage-dependent age at diagnosis not encodable.

contrast-enhancing tumor ... or recurrent intra-axial brain tumor (malignant glioma, astrocytoma, malignant ependymoma, AT/RT, Oligodendroglioma, etc.) published without Pediatric-Type Diffuse High-Grade Glioma (incl. Diffuse Midline Glioma, H3 K27-Altered), Glioblastoma, IDH-Wildtype, Pilocytic Astrocytoma or Medulloblastoma/embryonal tumours, so the commonest paediatric malignant gliomas cannot match.

Exclusions "Acute promyelocytic leukaemia (APL)", "Down syndrome ... myeloid leukaemia of Down syndrome" and "secondary AML after previous cancer therapy" not written although APL with PML-RARA, Myeloid Leukemia Associated with Down Syndrome and Therapy-Related Acute Myeloid Leukemia are nodes inside the published Acute Myeloid Leukemia subtree.

de novo or recurrent Germ cell tumour published only as Non-Seminomatous Germ Cell Tumor (Testis subtree); Ovarian Germ Cell Tumor (yolk sac, dysgerminoma, teratoma) and Extra Gonadal Germ Cell Tumor, the usual abdominal paediatric GCTs, cannot match. Minor: Inflammatory Myofibroblastic Tumor and Dendritic Cell Sarcoma are not "soft-tissue sarcoma".
Male and female patients with allogenic transplant indication for ALL published as B-Lymphoblastic Leukemia/Lymphoma only; T-Lymphoblastic Leukemia/Lymphoma missing. Age >=0.25 to <26 correct.

unresectable advanced or metastatic R/R OSA (Cohort 2) or ... STS published as Osteosarcoma + the standard STS list (age >=12 correct); judgement calls only: Solitary Fibrous Tumor/Hemangiopericytoma not listed, while Inflammatory Myofibroblastic Tumor and kidney/liver rhabdoid nodes are listed.

The single arm requires Neuroblastoma, so the "malignant CCT i.e. malignant pheochromocytoma or malignant paraganglioma" cohort (step Pheochromocytoma) and Ganglioneuroblastoma match no arm; Paraganglioma is missing entirely; step age <22 cuts off NB patients for whom the text sets only "Age >1 year" (age 1-21 applies to the CCT cohort). Ganglioneuroma (benign) is an extra diagnosis.

Diagnosis of a solid extra-cranial tumor like malignant lymphoma or malignant sarcoma published as _SOLID_ or _LIQUID_: _LIQUID_ pulls in leukaemias and myeloid neoplasms, and _SOLID_ includes intracranial (CNS/Brain) tumours the text leaves out. Age 6 to <41 correct.
acute leukemia (limited to AML or ALL) but published adds Acute Leukemias of Ambiguous Lineage (MPAL, AUL), which is neither. Solid tumours (_SOLID_), AML, B-/T-ALL and age 3 to <36 correct.

Immunocompromised patients including but not limited to those with any type of malignancy with BK/JC virus disease published as Merkel Cell Carcinoma only; patients with any other malignancy (e.g. post-HSCT leukaemia) cannot match. Should be _SOLID_/_LIQUID_ (or diagnosis-free).

MDS route includes "6) chronic myelomonocytic leukemia, 7) atypical MDS/myeloproliferative syndromes" but only Chronic Myelomonocytic Leukemia is published; the other Myelodysplastic/Myeloproliferative Neoplasms (atypical CML, MDS/MPN unclassifiable) cannot match. Rest of list and age 15 to <81 correct.

Exclusion "Philadelphia chromosome (Ph)-positive ALL" not written although B-Lymphoblastic Leukemia/Lymphoma with t(9;22)(q34.1;q11.2);BCR-ABL1 is a node in the published subtree (or BCR-ABL1 fusion could be !excluded).
Broad allo-HSCT list for acute leukaemias, CML, MPN, MDS, CLL/SLL, B-/T-/NK-cell lymphomas, myeloma, JMML, MPAL; age "<= 60 years" published <61; IKZF1 correctly information only.

EC arms require Uterine Endometrioid Carcinoma PR+ ("well-differentiated (grade 1) endometrioid adenocarcinoma ... PgRs positive") but the four EAH arms carry no match, so they inherit the step's Endometrial Carcinoma and serous, clear-cell or carcinosarcoma patients match via them. EAH itself has no OncoTree code.

acute lymphocytic leukemia, Acute myeloid leukemia, Ambiguous lineage leukemia, myeloma published as AML, B-/T-LBL, Acute Leukemias of Ambiguous Lineage, Plasma Cell Myeloma; "Aged 4 to 80" as >=4 and <81.

acute promyelocytic leukemia (APML) are NOT eligible, "ML-DS are NOT eligible", "Philadelphia chromosome t(9;22) positive leukemia (Ph+ ... AML, MPAL)" not written although APL with PML-RARA, Myeloid Leukemia Associated with Down Syndrome, AML with BCR-ABL1 and Mixed Phenotype Acute Leukemia with t(9;22) are nodes inside the published AML and Ambiguous Lineage subtrees.

Gene OR list (BCR-ABL1, T315I, RET, FLT3, KIT, PDGFRB, TEK, KDR, SRC) is required of everyone, but Phase 1 admits "ALL. AML. Other leukemias. Lymphoma. Any other tumors ... for which standard therapy is not available" with no mutation; also gene-missing for Group B ("FGFR" FGFR1-4, "PDGFR" PDGFRA, EPH receptors).

primary bone sarcoma with exclusion "All soft tissue sarcomas (including ... Ewing soft tissue sarcomas) and chordomas", yet published lists Chordoma, Ewing Sarcoma of Soft Tissue and the full STS list (synovial, rhabdomyosarcoma, liposarcoma, DSRCT ...). Only bone histologies plus UPS, LMS and angiosarcoma (named in text) belong.

primary or relapsed solid tumor or lymphoma published as _SOLID_ only, so lymphoma patients cannot match; exclusion "Patients with brain tumors" not written (CNS/Brain nodes stay inside _SOLID_). Unilateral vs bilateral Wilms not encodable.
ALL (incl. MPAL), AML incl. therapy-related, MDS, Hodgkin and non-Hodgkin lymphoma published; non-malignant indications not encodable; "age 0-30" as >=0 and <31; FLT3 correctly information only.

Multiple Myeloma ... and Plasmacytoid Lymphoma (WHO 2008 lymphoplasmacytic/lymphoplasmacytoid lymphoma, CD19+) published as Plasma Cell Myeloma + Plasmablastic Lymphoma: Lymphoplasmacytic Lymphoma is missing and Plasmablastic Lymphoma is a different entity the text does not name.
H3K27M or H3K27I mutation DMG, age 2-60: DMG H3 K27-altered AND H3-3A/H3-3B/H3C2/H3C3 any variation, >=2 <61.
neuroblastoma (NBL) or ganglioneuroblastoma, "Less than 30 years": NB/GNB, <30.
histologically proven prostate cancer published as Prostate Adenocarcinoma, male; no age bounds in text.

CNS tumor that is recurrent, progressive, or refractory with the exception of diffuse midline gliomas (DMG) published as HGG NOS + pediatric HGG H3/IDH-wt only, so medulloblastoma, ependymoma, ATRT, glioblastoma etc. cannot match (loses); and Diffuse Midline Glioma, H3 K27-Altered is published as an inclusion although explicitly excluded (over-match, wrong diagnosis).
CD19+ B-ALL (cohorts A-D incl. any B-ALL with CNS relapse), 0-29: B-ALL, >=0 <30; KMT2A cohort gene correctly not required.
Acute Leukemias (AML, ALL) in morphologic complete remission, 14-65: AML + B-ALL + T-ALL (+ambiguous-lineage acute leukaemias, acceptable under 'Acute Leukemias'), >=14 <66.

Patients with acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL, t(15;17)) excluded but Acute Myeloid Leukemia is published with no !APL with PML-RARA (over-match); "AML/MDS" published as six named MDS subtypes only, so Myelodysplastic Syndromes NOS, MDS with Excess Blasts (parent), MDS-U, MDS del(5q) and Refractory Cytopenia of Childhood cannot match (loses, missing-diagnosis).
histologically confirmed FLHCC only, but Hepatocellular Carcinoma (a sibling node, not a parent of Fibrolamellar Carcinoma) is published as an alternative, admitting conventional HCC.
elective primary solid tumor resection but _LIQUID_ is published beside _SOLID_, admitting every haematological malignancy.

CD19+ B-ALL and "DLBCL (NOS), FL, ... PMBCL, and HGBCL" but _LIQUID_ is published as an alternative, admitting AML, T-ALL, myeloma etc.; also cohort ages (B-ALL "3-70", B-NHL "18-75") merged to >=3 <76, admitting B-NHL aged 3-17.
Study 2: "Unilateral Retinoblastoma in children below 6 months of age" is eligible, but the step publishes age >=0.5 globally, so infants under 6 months cannot match.

Hodgkin lymphoma or non-Hodgkin lymphoma are not permitted yet Hodgkin Lymphoma, Mature B-Cell/T-NK Neoplasms, B-LBL and T-LBL are published as inclusions (over-match); and the Feasibility Cohort ("relapsed or refractory solid tumor") arm requires Rhabdomyosarcoma like the RMS arm, so non-RMS solid tumours cannot match any arm (loses).
Patient has diagnosis of acute promyelocytic leukemia (or AML M3) excluded, but Acute Myeloid Leukemia is published without !APL with PML-RARA. FLT3 only on the FLT3-ITD expansion arm is correct.

Myelofibrosis published as Primary Myelofibrosis only; post-PV and post-ET myelofibrosis (Polycythaemia Vera Myelofibrosis, Essential Thrombocythemia Myelofibrosis, separate nodes) cannot match. Rest (AML, ALL, CMML, MDS, NHL, HL, MM, CLL, CML, 16-70) correct.
Stage IVB retinoblastoma with CNS metastasis: Retinoblastoma, no age bounds in text.

primary extra-cranial solid tumor and "Patients with documented CNS tumor ... will be excluded" but published as _SOLID_ with no !CNS/Brain, admitting primary brain tumours. GPC3 IHC correctly not encoded.
High-risk neuroblastoma in CR: NB/GNB, no age bounds; MYCN risk-group gene correctly not required.
CD20 positive DLBCL, excludes primary CNS/skin lymphoma and "TP53 mutations": DLBCL NOS, >=14 <76, TP53 !Mutation.
Title restricts to "B-linear Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia" (eligibility says "diagnosis of ALL") but T-Lymphoblastic Leukemia/Lymphoma is also published; infant T-ALL is very rare.
histologically-confirmed adamantinomatous craniopharyngioma (ACP) only, but _SOLID_ is published as an alternative in the step, admitting every solid tumour.
CD19+ relapsed or refractory B-ALL, 1-25: B-ALL, >=1 <26.
grade 3a or 3b FL published as Follicular Lymphoma (all grades; OncoTree has no grade nodes) - OncoTree limitation; DLBCL NOS, PMBCL, >=14 otherwise correct.

Age >=18 years, Phase 2 Cohort 2f only: Age >=12 ... DDI sub-study Cohorts G and H only: age 18-60 made global as >=12 <61, so ALK+ patients aged 61+ cannot match Phase 1/Phase 2 (loses); and the required "documented ALK rearrangement or activating ALK mutation" is not published at all (no ALK genomic criterion), with _SOLID_ instead of NSCLC/solid ALK+ (over-match, gene-missing).

Step (_LIQUID_ etc., 1-21) correct for "Relapsed and/or refractory hematologic malignancy"; but Part 2 Cohorts A/B/C arms are restricted to BPDCN although Part 2 admits all diagnoses ("First or greater relapse") - curator would fix arms, yet every patient still matches the trial via the open Part 1 arm.
CD19+ ALL or Lly, 0-29: B-LBL/B-ALL, >=0 <30; CD19 antigen correctly not a gene.

Age >=8, solid/CNS tumour; arm A BRAF fusion without RAS mutation, arms B-D BRAF V600E without NF1/RAS. Odd arm C er_status !Positive and AR/ESR1 !Any Variation, plus C's unwritten exclusions (colorectal, PDAC, melanoma, PTC, NSCLC), are absorbed by Subprotocol D ("solid tumor harboring a BRAF V600E mutation and not eligible for other subprotocols"), so no patient is lost or wrongly admitted.

aggressive mature B-NHL that expresses CD20, including BL, BAL, DLBCL, and PMBCL published as Burkitt, DLBCL NOS and PMBCL only; High-Grade B-Cell Lymphoma (NOS / with MYC and BCL2/BCL6 rearrangements), Burkitt-Like Lymphoma with 11q Aberration and LBCL with IRF4 rearrangement are missing. These are real paediatric aggressive B-NHL groups. Ages 0.5 to <30 are fine.
Exclusion "diagnosis of acute promyelocytic leukemia (APML)" not written; Acute Myeloid Leukemia subtree includes "APL with PML-RARA", which needs !APL with PML-RARA. Age >=2 is fine.
Text "Age ≥ 18 years and ≤ 90 years" published as >=15 (registry minimum); 15-17-year-olds with Hodgkin lymphoma can match although the text excludes them.
R/R B-ALL, age ">= 1 years of age and less than 25 years" published as B-Lymphoblastic Leukemia/Lymphoma, >=1, <25. Trisomy 21 and CD19/CD22 expression are not encodable.

Relapsed/refractory "solid or hematologic malignancy including brain tumours" published as _SOLID_ or _LIQUID_. Text "Ages 4-17" published as >=4, <19 (registry 18); a one-year difference at the maximum is not an error.

Exclusion "Patients with Philadelphia chromosome positive (Ph+) ALL" not written although "B-Lymphoblastic Leukemia/Lymphoma with t(9;22)(q34.1;q11.2);BCR-ABL1" has its own node inside the published B-LL subtree. B-ALL/T-ALL and ages 1-22 are otherwise fine.
relapsed or refractory solid tumor, age >1 and ≤25, published as _SOLID_, >=1, <26.

Confirmed diagnosis of high-risk NB published as Neuroblastoma only. It is the only neuroblastoma trial in the set without Ganglioneuroblastoma, which the pipeline adds by convention, and high-risk nodular GNB is treated as high-risk NB. Age >=1 is fine.

CD19-positive relapsed/refractory B-cell hematolymphatic malignancies published as Mature B-Cell Neoplasms only; B-Lymphoblastic Leukemia/Lymphoma (CD19+ R/R B-ALL, the main CD19 CAR target) is missing. Mature B-Cell Neoplasms also pulls in Plasma Cell Myeloma/plasmacytoma (usually CD19-negative), a minor over-match.

Confirmed metastatic fusion-driven rhabdomyosarcoma published as the Rhabdomyosarcoma parent, which also admits fusion-negative Embryonal and Pleomorphic RMS. It needs Alveolar RMS or a FOXO1 structural variation. Ewing and synovial sarcoma and ages 2-40 are fine.
R/R B-ALL "12 years and above", Ph+ allowed; published as B-Lymphoblastic Leukemia/Lymphoma, >=12.

The arm-level match allows only "Low-Grade Glioma, NOS" or "Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma", so "low-grade glioma ... WHO grade 1 or 2" patients coded as Pilocytic Astrocytoma, Pediatric-Type Diffuse LGG (MAPK-altered etc.) or PLNTY, and "pancreatic cancer (histologically not specified)" patients with acinar, adenosquamous or neuroendocrine histology, are blocked although the step tree lists them. Cohort B "18 years or older" is not applied to the pancreatic branch (>=12), a minor over-match.

Patients with oligodendroglioma, IDH-mutant and 1p/19q-codeleted are not eligible, yet both Oligodendroglioma IDH-mutant 1p/19q-codeleted nodes are published as inclusions. IDH1 R132H/C/S/G/L and ages 12 to <40 are fine; "Patients with IDH2 mutations are not eligible" is also unwritten (minor).

Newly diagnosed high-risk pre-B ALL or T-ALL, age 1-19; published as B-LL and T-LL, >=1, <20. Risk-group genes KMT2A/iAMP21 correctly left in genes_not_required, and Burkitt is outside the B-LL subtree.

solid tumor, CNS tumor or lymphoma published as _SOLID_ or _LIQUID_; _LIQUID_ admits leukaemias and myeloid neoplasms that the text never includes. It should be _SOLID_ plus the lymphoma nodes. Age <21 is fine.
R/R multiple myeloma, "Age ≥ 18 years"; published as Plasma Cell Myeloma, >=18. Plasma cell leukaemia and amyloidosis have no separate node.

Ph+ (BCR-ABL1 positive) ALL exclusion published as BCR and ABL1 '!Any Variation' (plus '!Structural Variation'). This shuts out Ph-negative B-ALL with any other ABL1 or BCR alteration, e.g. Ph-like ABL-class fusions (NUP214::ABL1, ETV6::ABL1), which the text admits. It should exclude BCR SV with fusion_partner ABL1 or the t(9;22) node. Age 15-65 is fine.

relapse or refractory CD5+ T-cell malignancies published with B-cell entities as well: B-Lymphoblastic Leukemia/Lymphoma and its subtypes, PMBCL, T-Cell/Histiocyte-Rich Large B-Cell Lymphoma, Primary Cutaneous DLBCL Leg Type and Primary Cutaneous Follicle Center Lymphoma. T-LL, ETP-ALL and Mature T and NK Neoplasms are correct; age 1-70 is fine.
R/R CD33+ AML, "Age 1-70"; published as Acute Myeloid Leukemia, >=1, <71. CD33 is expression only.
B-ALL relapsed after alloHSCT, "Age ≤65"; published as B-Lymphoblastic Leukemia/Lymphoma, <66.
R/R CD19+/CD22+ B-ALL, "Age from 1 to 70"; published as B-Lymphoblastic Leukemia/Lymphoma, >=1, <71.

KMT2A-r, NPM1-m, or NUP98-r acute leukemia, age 0-21; published as AML/ALL/MPAL/AUL nodes AND (KMT2A SV or NPM1 Mutation or NUP98 SV), >=0, <22. The unwritten APL exclusion is practically moot under the gene requirement, and JMML is outside the published nodes.

B-precursor B-ALL or DLBCL/Burkitt lymphoma ... neuroblastoma or Ewing sarcoma published with _LIQUID_ and _SOLID_ in the same OR as the named nodes, so every tumour matches. The wildcards should be dropped. Ages 0.5 to <26 are fine.

Text includes "G3 GEP-NET", "NEN of other sites, and NEN of unknown primary" and "Pheochromocytoma and paraganglioma (PPGL)", but only Lung NET, Thymic NET and Pheochromocytoma are published: Paraganglioma, G3 GEP-NETs (Pancreatic/GI NET) and Neuroendocrine Tumor NOS are missing (loses). Lung Neuroendocrine Tumor also pulls in Small Cell Lung Cancer and Large Cell NEC although the text excludes "neuroendocrine carcinomas (NECs)" (over-match).
Reference pathological proven diagnosis of DSRCT ... or SySa, "Age from 13 to 50 years": published DSRCT or Synovial Sarcoma, >=13 <51. SSTR expression not encodable.

refractory Diffuse Large B-cell Lymphoma, primary mediastinal B cell lymphoma or transformed follicular lymphoma or other B-cell lymphoma according to WHO classification published as DLBCL NOS/FL/PMBCL only; Burkitt, High-Grade B-Cell Lymphoma, EBV+ DLBCL, MCL, MZL etc. cannot match. Also the ALL-cohort bound "(Age 0-60 years)" is applied globally as <61, shutting out lymphoma patients over 60 (subgroup age).
Patient is >= 18 years of age at the time of signing the informed consent published as age >=14 (registry minimumAge), so 14-17-year-olds match a trial the text closes to them.

pseudomyxoma peritonei from a primary mucinous epithelial tumours of the appendix (low and high grade) published as Peritoneal Serous Carcinoma: Low-grade Appendiceal Mucinous Neoplasm / Mucinous Adenocarcinoma of the Appendix missing, and an unrelated entity (peritoneal serous carcinoma) matches instead (extra-diagnosis).
Evidence of T-ALL or T-LBL ... relapse/refractory or MRD positive, "Lower age limit of >= 6 months": published T-Lymphoblastic Leukemia/Lymphoma, >=0.5.

Proof of RRD: By tumor immunohistochemistry showing functional loss of mismatch repair gene expression ... or based on prior germline testing published as mmr_status MMR-Deficient AND ms_status MSS AND a required MLH1/MSH2/MSH6/PMS2 variant: MSS requirement shuts out MSI-H RRD gliomas, gene requirement shuts out IHC-proven cases without a recorded variant (e.g. MLH1 silencing, POLE). Over-match: "histologically confirmed diagnosis of glioblastoma" published with grade-3 entities (Anaplastic Ganglioglioma, Anaplastic PXA, Astrocytoma IDH-mutant Grade 3, Oligodendroglioma Grade 3) - title says HGG, so this part is borderline.

Participants must be age <= 21 years at initial diagnosis published as current age <22 (registry convention), losing only rare >21-year-olds diagnosed at <=21; both arms carry match Neuroblastoma only, silently dropping the Ganglioneuroblastoma the step adds (text names only neuroblastoma, so not a text loss).
relapse or refractory T-ALL or T-LLy, "1mo to 21 years": published T-Lymphoblastic Leukemia/Lymphoma, >=0.08 <22.

Immunophenotyping: acute B-lymphoblastic leukemia published as B-Lymphoblastic OR T-Lymphoblastic Leukemia/Lymphoma; T-ALL is never admitted by the text. Age "older than 1 month to younger than 18 years" correctly >=0.08 <18.
B7-H3 positive solid tumor, "Age 1 - 25 years": published _SOLID_, >=1 <26; B7-H3 (CD276) is an antigen, correctly not matched.
localized high-risk or very high-risk prostate cancer: published Prostate Adenocarcinoma, male, no age bound in text.

Histologically confirmed GD2-positive osteogenic sarcoma, Ewing's sarcoma, soft tissue and undifferentiated sarcomas published as ARMS/ERMS/Ewing/Osteosarcoma only; other soft tissue sarcomas (synovial sarcoma, spindle cell/sclerosing RMS, undifferentiated sarcomas etc.) cannot match. Age "under 18" correctly <18.
High-risk neuroblastoma ... resistant / relapsed: published Neuroblastoma (+ Ganglioneuroblastoma by design), registry age 2-16 as >=2 <17.

relapsed non-WNT, non-SHH medulloblastoma confirmed by ... assay published with the Medulloblastoma parent (pulls Medulloblastoma, WNT Subtype and SHH Subtype) plus Desmoplastic/Nodular, MBEN and Large Cell/Anaplastic parents (each with an SHH Subtype child); no !WNT/!SHH exclusion written although those nodes exist. Medulloblastoma, Non-WNT, Non-SHH and Anaplastic Non-WNT Non-SHH should be the codes.
Newly diagnosed Ph-negative B-ALL ... / Ph-positive B-ALL, MRD positive in CR1, ">=16 and <=70 years": published B-Lymphoblastic Leukemia/Lymphoma, >=16 <71; BCR correctly informational.

Diagnosis of r/r NK/T lymphoma published as Extranodal NK-/T-Cell Lymphoma, Nasal Type; but title/conditions say "CD7-Positive Natural Killer/T Cell Malignancies" and "Bone marrow lymphoblasts >=5%" suggests lymphoblastic NK/T disease (T-LBL/NK lymphoblastic) is intended - text ambiguous.

Histologically confirmed Fibrolamellar hepatocellular carcinoma (FL-HCC) or other malignant disease ... Presence of DNAJB1-PRKACA fusion transcript published as Fibrolamellar Carcinoma AND the fusion; other fusion-positive tumours (e.g. Intraductal Oncocytic Papillary Neoplasm) cannot match. Diagnosis should be _SOLID_ (or open) with the PRKACA/DNAJB1 fusion as the gate.

pathologically confirmed classical Hodgkin lymphoma and exclusion "Diagnosed with lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma", but published includes the Hodgkin Lymphoma parent, which pulls Nodular Lymphocyte-Predominant Hodgkin Lymphoma; no !NLPHL written.

molecularly or histologically confirmed embryonal tumor with multilayered rosettes published as the Embryonal Tumor parent (27 descendants: medulloblastoma, AT/RT, PNET ...); should be Embryonal Tumor with Abundant Neuropil and True Rosettes. "Participants of any age": no age correctly.

Philadelphia chromosome positive ALL (Ph-ALL) excluded via !ABL1 and !BCR Any Variation, which is broader than Ph (any BCR/ABL1 alteration) while the B-ALL with t(9;22) BCR-ABL1 OncoTree node is not excluded (Ph+ coded by diagnosis without a recorded variant still matches). Age "older than 1 year and younger than 18" correct; risk group not encodable.
histologically or cytologically confirmed adrenocortical carcinoma, "Age 12 years and above": published Adrenocortical Carcinoma, >=12.

Prior history of head and neck cancer with no active disease published as Head and Neck Carcinoma, Other only; Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma, Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma, Salivary Carcinoma etc. cannot match. Gender Female follows registry/exclusion "Pregnant/post-menopausal, or male" but inclusion says "Non-pregnant/post-menopausal, or male" (text self-contradictory).
pathological diagnosis of neuroblastoma, INRG M/INSS 4, "Age >=18 months and <=18 years": published Neuroblastoma (+GNB by design), >=1.5 <19.

Histologically confirmed CD20+ PTLD including the below subtypes: Polymorphic, Monomorphic published with the Posttransplant Lymphoproliferative Disorders parent, which also pulls Classical Hodgkin Lymphoma PTLD (CD20-negative) and non-destructive PTLDs (florid follicular, IM, plasmacytic hyperplasia); "including" makes it a judgement call. Age >=15 correct.

ARM3 "KIT mutations (loci: D816, N822, exon 8) ... no TP53 mutations, AML/MR, FLT3-ITD" and ARM2 "FLT3-ITD ... no TP53 mutation, and no AML/MR" both published as requiring AML with Myelodysplasia-Related Changes, the very diagnosis those arms exclude: FLT3-ITD/KIT patients cannot reach their arm, AML-MR patients are routed there; ARM3 also limited to KIT exon 8 missense (D816/N822 missing). Trial-level matching survives only through ARM4 (all AML/MDS); ARM1's TP53/AML-MR gene route also reduced to the AML-MR diagnosis.

Relapsed/refractory ALK-positive ALCL, 1-<40 (registry 39 Years); ALK required (Any Variation step-level, SV on the LR arm); "ALK-NEGATIVE anaplastic large cell lymphoma" excluded by the ALK+ leaf. Vinblastine/Down syndrome exclusions not encodable.
new diagnosis of Ewing sarcoma, ">1 year old": Ewing Sarcoma + Ewing Sarcoma of Soft Tissue, >=1. Marrow metastasis and "hematologic malignancy" history are stage/history, not encodable.

High risk hematologic malignancy ... This includes (but is not limited to) ALL, AML, MDS, CML, NK/biphenotypic leukaemia: _LIQUID_ plus the named entities, age <22 ("less than or equal to 21 years"); the open list justifies _LIQUID_.

relapse or refractory CD5+ T-cell malignancies: published list also contains B-cell entities - B-Lymphoblastic Leukemia/Lymphoma and all its subtypes, Primary Cutaneous DLBCL Leg Type, Primary Cutaneous Follicle Center Lymphoma, PMBCL, T-Cell/Histiocyte-Rich Large B-Cell Lymphoma - which the text never includes. T-cell entities and age 1-<71 correct.
R/R CD19+ B-ALL (title "Pediatric B-cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia"), "Age 1 - 18 years": B-Lymphoblastic Leukemia/Lymphoma, >=1, <19; CD19 correctly an antigen, not matched.

R/R CD22+ B-ALL, >=12 at step level ("12 years old in Module 2") correct; but arm-level limits not written: Module 1 "16 years old" and Module 2 / backfill "R/R Ph(-) B-ALL" only, so a 12-15-year-old Ph+ B-ALL patient can match although no module admits them (small group; Burkitt correctly outside B-LBL).

Newly diagnosed Philadelphia chromosome-positive or BCR::ABL1-positive B-ALL, 1 month-<18: leaf B-ALL with t(9;22) AND BCR-ABL1 SV; correct in substance but a patient coded with the B-ALL parent plus the fusion (or the leaf without a recorded fusion) cannot match - the parent with the required fusion would be safer.

metastatic or locally advanced and unresectable solid tumor, >=18 or >=16 for "Ewing Sarcoma or other malignancies for which there is a biological rationale": _SOLID_ plus Ewing, >=16; the 16-17 window is investigator discretion for any tumour, so acceptable.
newly diagnosed ... AML with "Presence of an NPM1 mutation", >=12: AML + NPM1 Mutation. APL exclusion not written but APL and NPM1-mutated AML are mutually exclusive in practice.

recurrent or progressive posterior fossa A (PFA) ependymoma, 1-39: no PFA code in OncoTree; Ependymomal Tumor parent (needed for Anaplastic Ependymoma) also admits Myxopapillary Ependymoma and Subependymoma and supratentorial/spinal ependymoma, which are not PFA. OncoTree limitation.

Exclusions "Acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL)" and "Down syndrome" not written although APL with PML-RARA and Myeloid Proliferations Related to Down Syndrome are descendants of the published Acute Myeloid Leukemia, so both match. AML 6 months-<18 otherwise correct (JMML is outside AML).
RRMM with extramedullary/paramedullary disease: Plasma Cell Myeloma, no age stated. PCL/POEMS/amyloidosis exclusions have no separate node; Waldenstrom is a different node.

CNS embryonal tumor ... OR ependymoma incl. "Other CNS embryonal tumor types", 2-<22 ("less than or equal to 21 years"): Embryonal Tumor, Ependymomal Tumor, Pineoblastoma etc. B7-H3 is an antigen. (Olfactory Neuroblastoma sits under OncoTree Embryonal Tumor - minor.)

Title/conditions "Ph-like ALL" with arms for "ABL class fusions" and "JAK pathway alterations": published all B-ALL subtypes (incl. Ph+ t(9;22), ETV6-RUNX1, KMT2A...) plus T-Lymphoblastic Leukemia/Lymphoma instead of B-Lymphoblastic Leukemia/Lymphoma, BCR-ABL1 Like, so T-ALL and non-Ph-like B-ALL match. Age 14-<61 correct.
Refractory/metastatic osteosarcoma, 12-65: Osteosarcoma, >=12, <66.
Text only says "CDK4/6-dependent solid tumors" (no diagnosis or age restriction otherwise): _SOLID_, no age; CDK4/6 dependence not encodable.

AML ... or with MDS/AML as defined by ICC (with 10%-20% blasts): Myelodysplastic Syndromes parent admits low-blast MDS (MDS-SLD, ring sideroblasts, del(5q), Refractory Cytopenia of Childhood) that the text never includes; MDS with Excess Blasts would be closer. Exclusions as gene !SV (RARA and RUNX1 !SV also drop rare variant-RARA/non-RUNX1T1 fusions - minor); >=14 correct.

Newly diagnosed ... Ph-negative ALL: no BCR/ABL1 exclusion and no !B-ALL with t(9;22) published, so Ph+ B-ALL matches. B-ALL/T-ALL and age 14-<61 correct; Burkitt and ambiguous-lineage exclusions are outside the published nodes.
HRNB with metastatic disease, ">=18 months to <18 years": Neuroblastoma + Ganglioneuroblastoma (by design), >=1.5, <18.
Newly diagnosed Ph-negative B-ALL, 15-65: B-LBL >=15 <66 with BCR and ABL1 !SV; T-ALL/MPAL/mature B outside the node; B-lymphoblastic lymphoma exclusion not separable in OncoTree.

Title "High-Risk Acute Leukemias and Myelodysplastic Syndrome", conditions "Acute Leukemia", text "HSCT for high-risk malignant disease": only AML, MDS and ambiguous-lineage leukaemia published; B-ALL and T-ALL (a main indication for TCRab-depleted HSCT in children) are missing. Age 1.5-<40 correct.

biochemically confirmed diagnosis of a phaeochromocytoma or paraganglioma: only Pheochromocytoma published; the existing Paraganglioma node is missing, so paraganglioma patients cannot match. Age >18 correct.
Oligometastatic castration-resistant prostate adenocarcinoma, male, no age: Prostate Adenocarcinoma, gender Male; non-adenocarcinoma histology excluded by the leaf.

Low/intermediate-grade DCIS, female <40: correct; but "Known BRCA1, BRCA2, or TP53 germline mutation carriers" published as somatic-level !Mutation on BRCA1/BRCA2/TP53, which would also drop a patient with only a somatic TP53/BRCA mutation in tumour sequencing (rarely done in DCIS).

Age >= 5 to <= 30 years published as >=0.42 (registry minimumAge 5 Months), so children 5 months-<5 years with osteosarcoma match though the text excludes them; upper bound <31 and Osteosarcoma correct.
